title: Wren and the Group Chat
author: Zephyrine Voss
blurb: Felix Delacroix, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before graduation.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
